home.title: Trusted home care with German standards
home.subtitle: Safe, compassionate care for the people you love, in the comfort of their own home in Alexandria.
home.intro_title: Care you can trust. Standards you can rely on.
home.intro_text: At Better Life Care, we believe exceptional care is about more than meeting everyday needs. It is about creating a feeling of comfort, dignity, security, and belonging. Every person deserves to be cared for with patience, respect, and genuine warmth.
home.services_title: Care that fits your family's life
home.services_subtitle: Seven services, one promise: safe, dignified care at home.
home.services_showcase_title: Thoughtful care, shaped around your life.
home.services_showcase_subtitle: From everyday support to skilled nursing, our services help families feel safer, more supported, and more at ease at home.
home.standards_title: The heart of care. The strength of German standards.
home.standards_text: Warm care needs a solid foundation. Our care routines, hygiene, safety practices, and professional conduct are guided by German standards, and our team is trained by a German healthcare consultant. Consistency, attention to detail, and professionalism are part of every visit.
home.how_subtitle: Three simple steps to get the care you need.
home.how_step_1_description: Call, message us on WhatsApp, or send an inquiry. We listen first.
home.how_step_2_description: We get to know the person, their routine, and their preferences, then suggest the right care.
home.how_step_3_description: A trained, caring professional starts, with clear communication with the family.
home.final_title: Here for You and Your Family, Whenever You Need Us.
home.final_text: Have questions or need guidance on the right care plan for your loved one? Speak directly with our dedicated care specialists today.
home.final_reassurance: Tell us how we can support your family.
home.why_choose_subtitle: What sets Better Life Care apart
home.why_choose_card_1_description: We follow healthcare training standards directly trained by German Experts in elderly care. Our nursing staff undergoes rigorous vetting and continuous weekly evaluations to guarantee clinical safety. We deliver complete clinical reliability and absolute peace of mind for your family.
home.why_choose_card_2_description: We apply active care principles that help your loved ones maintain their independence and self-determination. We respect daily personal routines while strictly protecting privacy and dignity at all times. Our focus is on nurturing the whole person with utmost respect and honor.
home.why_choose_card_3_title: Elevating Quality of Life & Human Connection
home.why_choose_card_3_description: We combine professional medical care with genuine warmth, empathy, and uplifting companionship. We encourage daily engagement and social interactions to enhance overall mental well-being. We aim to make every single day safer, easier, and more comfortable for your family.
home.why_choose_closing_title: More Than Care. A Better Way of Life.
home.why_choose_closing_text: At Better Life Care, we combine German-inspired professional standards, respect for human dignity, and genuine human connection to help your loved ones live with greater comfort, independence, and peace of mind.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
privacy.intro: Better Life Care is committed to protecting personal information, respecting family privacy, and providing transparent information about our care services.
privacy.privacy_1_body: At Better Life Care, respecting the privacy and dignity of you and your family is fundamental to everything we do. Our caregivers and nursing staff are trained according to German standards in elderly and home care by German specialists. We strictly adhere to international data protection standards, dedicated to protecting all personal and health-related information with absolute confidentiality.
privacy.privacy_2_intro: We only collect essential information required to deliver personalized, high-quality care, including:

information_items.label: Personal Details:
information_items.description: Name, contact number, email address, and home location.

information_items.label: Health & Care Data:
information_items.description: Medical reports, daily care requirements, and health updates provided directly by the family or prescribed by the treating physician.

use_items: Executing and supporting individual nursing and care plans in full alignment with the treating physician’s orders.
Maintaining transparent, ongoing communication with the patient’s family.
Ensuring quality, safety, and hygiene standards during care delivery.
We strictly do NOT sell, rent, or share your personal or medical data with third parties or marketing agencies under any circumstances.
privacy.privacy_4_body: We strictly enforce client confidentiality and home privacy protocols. All caregivers and clinical personnel sign binding confidentiality agreements to honor and preserve the privacy, comfort, and sanctity of every home we serve.
privacy.terms_1_title: 2.1 Scope of Services & Medical Liability Disclaimers
privacy.terms_1_body: The Better Life Care website provides information, care coordination, and home health support services. The content presented on this website is for informational and care guidance purposes only and does not replace direct professional medical diagnosis or advice from a treating physician. All clinical nursing procedures and medical interventions are executed strictly under the direction, supervision, and prescribed care plan of the patient’s treating physician.
privacy.terms_2_body: All care services are provided following an initial assessment coordinated directly with the family and the patient's medical team. While our staff is trained on rigorous safety and care protocols, families agree to provide accurate health details, medical reports, and treating physician instructions to ensure a safe, supportive environment for their loved ones.
privacy.terms_3_body: We reserve the right to update our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service periodically to remain aligned with professional and legal standards. Any revisions will be published directly on this page.
